raw_text: Breaking: First major ceasefire violation along the Line of Control since the February 2021 agreement. Pakistan Army resorted to unprovoked mortar shelling and small arms fire in the Poonch sector of Jammu and Kashmir. Indian Army responded strongly and effectively. Three border villages evacuated as a precautionary measure. Defence Ministry sources say situation is under control. Northern Command monitoring closely.
clean_text: First major LoC ceasefire violation since 2021 agreement. Pakistan shelled Poonch sector unprovoked. Indian Army responded. Three villages evacuated, situation under control.
